$BTC slipped to $83,782, up 1.08% in 24 h. It hit a high of $84,381 before easing back to the low of $82,563. Volume sat around 16,333 BTC, pushing quote volume past $1.36 B.

$ETH jumped to $2,704, climbing 2.07%. The pair rode up from $2,639 to a peak of $2,735, then settled near the top end. Trade flow was hefty, about 292,889 ETH, translating to $787 M in USDT.

$BNB edged higher to $763.42, up 0.29%. It ranged between $753.81 and $773.45, barely breaking the $770 mark. Volume hovered near 135,168 BNB, giving roughly $103 M of quote volume.

All three tokens stayed in tight bands, with BTC and ETH showing the clearest bounce off their lows. Keep an eye on whether $BTC can break back above $84 K and if $ETH holds above $2,730; $BNB's next move will likely hinge on any shift past $770. No wild swings yet, just a steady roll.

$MARSCOINUSDT ripped up 30.8% to $0.1547, flashing a high of $0.169 while volume swelled past 64 M USDT. $HBARUSDT followed, climbing 24.2% to $0.12019 and topping out at $0.13096, with over 212 M USDT changing hands. Meanwhile $ZECUSDT slid 11.6% down to $1,385.78, barely touching $1,599.73 at its peak and dragging 352 M USDT in volume. Bulls sprinting, bears still holding the line.
